notes.title: Korean is now added to CAFE 0 ~The Sleeping Beast~ REMASTERED
notes.notes:

The newest patch also contains some fixes for the wrong names on Germany version.
Thank you very much to LEE SO JEONG for the wonderful Korean translation!
